answer_1.quote: In this paper, we explore how Multimodal Vision & Language LLMs (VLMs) respond to ambiguous questions... We introduce RAC-QUET: A dataset of Referentially Ambiguous Questions about images.
answer_1.outputs: Textual answers (single or multiple referents) to ambiguous image‑based questions

answer_3.quote: We assess the performance of Meta-Llama-3-70B-Instruct ... by comparing its output to human-annotated labels.
methods: zero‑shot classification with detailed prompting and chain‑of‑thought

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 25 image‑question pairs ... collect annotations by four human participants ... 100 human responses were collected and evaluated.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators followed the class definitions (Explicit, Implicit, High Risk) to label model and human responses.
